literal: Shengzong, Part Eight
idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Eight

literal: In the fifth year of Taiping, spring, first month, on yiyou day, went to Hun River.
idiomatic: In the fifth year of Taiping, on yiyou day of the first spring month the court went to Hun River.

literal: In the second month, on wuwu day, forbade the realm from wearing bright gold and gold-thread brocade;
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the second month bright gold and gold-thread brocade were forbidden throughout the realm;

literal: imperial clansmen who should wear them must memorialize before use.
idiomatic: imperial clansmen who were entitled to wear them had to memorialize before use.

literal: That month, went to Yu'er Marsh.
idiomatic: That month the court went to Yu'er Marsh.

literal: In the third month, on renchen day, made Left Grand Chancellor Zhang Jian Wuding Army military commissioner and Associate Political Affairs Commissioner, Zheng Hongjie Linhuang vice prefect, Liu Shenxing Liaoxing Army military commissioner, Wuding Army military commissioner Xiao Pide Khitan palace metropolitan garrison commander, and Privy Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan Minister of Personnel, Associate Political Affairs Commissioner and concurrent Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the third month Left Grand Chancellor Zhang Jian was appointed Wuding Army military commissioner and Associate Political Affairs Commissioner; Zheng Hongjie was made Linhuang vice prefect; Liu Shenxing Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Wuding Army military commissioner Xiao Pide Khitan palace metropolitan garrison commander; and Privy Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan Minister of Personnel, Associate Political Affairs Commissioner, and concurrent Privy Commissioner.

literal: That month, went to Changchun River Yu'er Marsh; its waters overnight made a sound like thunder, crossed sand ridges forty li, and became a separate pond.
idiomatic: That month the court went to Changchun River Yu'er Marsh, where the waters overnight roared like thunder, crossed sand ridges forty li, and formed a separate pond.

literal: In summer, fifth month, took summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: Made Xiao Congshun Crown Prince Grand Preceptor, Wu Shuda Hanlin Academician, Daoist Feng Ruogu promoted to Crown Prince Palace Companion, Yelü Chen Wuding Army military commissioner, Zhang Jian Zhangxin Army military commissioner, Lü Shizong Assistant Director of Rites, and Li Keju Shunyi Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: Xiao Congshun was appointed Crown Prince Grand Preceptor; Wu Shuda Hanlin Academician; Daoist Feng Ruogu was promoted to Crown Prince Palace Companion; Yelü Chen Wuding Army military commissioner; Zhang Jian Zhangxin Army military commissioner; Lü Shizong Assistant Director of Rites; and Li Keju Shunyi Army military commissioner.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: In the ninth month, encamped at the Southern Capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court encamped at the Southern Capital.

literal: On jihai day, made Xiao Dilie and Li Shaoqi chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Yelü Shouning and Liu Siduan chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Emperor on his birthday.
idiomatic: On jihai day Xiao Dilie and Li Shaoqi were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Yelü Shouning and Liu Siduan chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Emperor on his birthday.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on xinwei day, Song Empress Dowager sent Feng Yuanzong and Shi Fang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the tenth winter month the Song Empress Dowager sent Feng Yuanzong and Shi Fang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.

literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, visited the inner orchard for a banquet; capital people gathered to watch.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the eleventh month the court visited the inner orchard for a banquet, and people of the capital gathered to watch.

literal: Held examinations for jinshi and selected seventy-two; ordered them to compose poetry and ranked them by skill; Zhang Yu and thirteen others were made Crown Prince proofreaders, Han Luan and fifty-eight others Chongwenguan proofreaders.
idiomatic: Jinshi examinations were held and seventy-two candidates were selected; they were ordered to compose poetry and were ranked by skill; Zhang Yu and thirteen others were appointed Crown Prince proofreaders, and Han Luan and fifty-eight others Chongwenguan proofreaders.

literal: On xinchou day, made Left Guard attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Luoluo Right yilibi.
idiomatic: On xinchou day Left Guard attendant langjun xiangwen Xiao Luoluo was appointed Right yilibi.

literal: In the twelfth month, on dingsi day, made Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Xiaoxian Upper Capital regent, imperial nephew Prince of Changsha Xiejianu Kuangyi Army military commissioner, and Yelü Renju Xingguo Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On dingsi day of the twelfth month Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Xiaoxian was appointed Upper Capital regent; imperial nephew Prince of Changsha Xiejianu Kuangyi Army military commissioner; and Yelü Renju Xingguo Army military commissioner.

literal: On jiazi day, made Xiao Shouning Palace Front inspector general of the imperial guard horse and foot.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Xiao Shouning was appointed Palace Front inspector general of the imperial guard horse and foot.

literal: On yichou day, Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Hezhuo died.
idiomatic: On yichou day Northern Privy Commissioner Xiao Hezhuo died.

literal: On wuchen day, made Northern Chancellor Xiao Pugu Northern Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Northern Chancellor Xiao Pugu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner.

literal: On jisi day, dispatched Xiao Xie and Li Qi as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On jisi day Xiao Xie and Li Qi were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

literal: On gengwu day, made Associate Political Affairs Commissioner Liu Jing Shunyi Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Associate Political Affairs Commissioner Liu Jing was appointed Shunyi Army military commissioner.

literal: On yihai day, Song envoys Li Wei and Zhang Lun came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On yihai day Song envoys Li Wei and Zhang Lun came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: That year, because the grain harvest in Yan was abundant, when the imperial carriage visited, the people competed to offer local products.
idiomatic: That year, because the grain harvest in Yan was abundant, when the imperial carriage visited the people competed to offer local products.

literal: The Emperor honored the aged, benefited widows and orphans, and granted communal drinking.
idiomatic: The Emperor honored the aged, benefited widows and orphans, and granted communal drinking.

literal: By evening the lamps of the six streets were bright as day; gentry and common people amused themselves, and the Emperor also went incognito to watch.
idiomatic: By evening the lamps of the six streets shone bright as day; gentry and common people amused themselves, and the Emperor also went incognito to watch.

literal: On dingchou day, forbade artisans from destroying gold and silver vessels.
idiomatic: On dingchou day artisans were forbidden to destroy gold and silver vessels.

literal: In the sixth year of Taiping, spring, first month, on the jimao new moon, Song sent Xu Shi, Pei Jiji, Zhang Ruogu, and Cui Zhun to congratulate.
idiomatic: In the sixth year of Taiping, on the jimao new moon of the first spring month Song sent Xu Shi, Pei Jiji, Zhang Ruogu, and Cui Zhun with congratulations.

literal: On gengchen day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: In the second month, on jiyou day, made Miliji Associate Privy Commissioner, Huang Pian army cavalry commander with Dabguzhi as vice, Sheshi as overseer, and led troops to fortify the area between Hun River and Shumu River.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the second month Miliji was appointed Associate Privy Commissioner; Huang Pian was made army cavalry commander with Dabguzhi as vice and Sheshi as overseer, and led troops to fortify the area between Hun River and Shumu River.

literal: Huanglong Prefecture requested building three fortifications and ten beacon towers; an edict ordered them built in farming intervals.
idiomatic: Huanglong Prefecture requested three fortifications and ten beacon towers; an edict ordered them built during farming intervals.

literal: Eastern Capital regent Bage memorialized that Huang Pian led troops into Jurchen territory to raid land, capturing people, horses, cattle, and pigs beyond counting and receiving two hundred seventy surrendering households; an edict praised and instructed him.
idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent Bage reported that Huang Pian had led troops into Jurchen territory to raid, capturing people, horses, cattle, and pigs beyond counting and receiving two hundred seventy surrendering households; an edict praised and instructed him.

literal: On wuwu day, made Yelü Ye deputy inspector; Imperial Uncle's Household Xiao Liushi and Tulügu were put in charge of the Northwestern Route Twelve-Ban Army and the Xi Prince's House Sheli Army.
idiomatic: On wuwu day Yelü Ye was appointed deputy inspector; Imperial Uncle's Household Xiao Liushi and Tulügu were put in charge of the Northwestern Route Twelve-Ban Army and the Xi Prince's House Sheli Army.

literal: On jisi day, the Southern Capital flooded; envoys were dispatched to relieve it.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Southern Capital flooded, and envoys were dispatched to provide relief.

literal: On gengwu day, edict ordered the Tangut sub-tribe Taxi to establish a Khitan military commissioner to govern them.
idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict ordered the Tangut sub-tribe Taxi to establish a Khitan military commissioner to govern them.

literal: In the third month, on the wuyin new moon, made Datong Army military commissioner Zhang Jian enter service as Southern Privy Commissioner, Left Grand Chancellor, and Political Affairs Commissioner; Associate Political Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda was demoted to Assistant Director of Palace Construction and sent out as Dongzhou prefect.
idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the third month Datong Army military commissioner Zhang Jian entered service as Southern Privy Commissioner, Left Grand Chancellor, and Political Affairs Commissioner; Associate Political Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda was demoted to Assistant Director of Palace Construction and sent out as Dongzhou prefect.

literal: That month, Zubu invaded; Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Hui defeated them.
idiomatic: That month the Zubu invaded, and Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Hui defeated them.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on the dingwei new moon, made Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Honggu tiyin.
idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the fourth summer month Wuding Army military commissioner Yelü Honggu was appointed tiyin.

literal: On wushen day, the Puloumaoduo tribe had many Wuren households; an edict ordered them demanded.
idiomatic: On wushen day the Puloumaoduo tribe had many Wuren households; an edict ordered them surrendered.

literal: On bingyin day, went to Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court went to Yong'an Mountain.

literal: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, made Eastern Capital army commander Xiao Kaogu Khitan palace metropolitan garrison commander.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fifth month Eastern Capital army commander Xiao Kaogu was appointed Khitan palace metropolitan garrison commander.

literal: On guimao day, dispatched Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Hui to lead troops against the Ganzhou Uighurs.
idiomatic: On guimao day Northwestern Route pacification commissioner Xiao Hui was dispatched to lead troops against the Ganzhou Uighurs.

literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, edict ordered all official livestock to be branded on the left for identification.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the sixth month an edict ordered all official livestock branded on the left for identification.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on wushen day, hunted at Heiling.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Heiling.

literal: In the eighth month, Xiao Hui attacked Ganzhou without success and the army returned.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Xiao Hui attacked Ganzhou without success and the army returned.

literal: From this the Zubu tribes all rebelled; Liao armies fought them and were all defeated; overseer Nieligu and Imperial Uncle's Household Grand Guardian Habülü died.
idiomatic: From this the Zubu tribes all rebelled; Liao armies fought them and were all defeated; overseer Nieligu and Imperial Uncle's Household Grand Guardian Habülü were killed.

literal: An edict dispatched tiyin Yelü Honggu, linya Huage, and others to lead troops to suppress them.
idiomatic: An edict dispatched tiyin Yelü Honggu, linya Huage, and others to lead troops against them.

literal: In the ninth month, encamped at the Liao River bank.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court encamped at the Liao River bank.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, chiefs of the Yasuguan tribes came to court.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the tenth winter month chiefs of the Yasuguan tribes came to court.

literal: On gengchen day, dispatched envoys to inquire into the reason Xia State fought Song in the fifth month.
idiomatic: On gengchen day envoys were dispatched to inquire into the reason Xia State had fought Song in the fifth month.

literal: On xinsi day, made former Southern Great King Zhilugun chief xiangwen of Ugu and Dilie.
idiomatic: On xinsi day former Southern Great King Zhilugun was appointed chief xiangwen of Ugu and Dilie.

literal: On gengyin day, made Xiao Xiaoshun and Xiao Shaozong concurrent Palace Attendants, imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaoye Political Affairs Commissioner, former Southern Great King Huzhijin Associate Upper Capital regent, and Ange Tonghua Prefecture military commissioner.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Xiao Xiaoshun and Xiao Shaozong were appointed concurrent Palace Attendants; imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaoye Political Affairs Commissioner; former Southern Great King Huzhijin Associate Upper Capital regent; and Ange Tonghua Prefecture military commissioner.

literal: In the eleventh month, on yichou day, Song sent Han Yi and Tian Chengshuo to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the eleventh month Song sent Han Yi and Tian Chengshuo to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.

literal: On wuchen day, Northwestern Route pacification office sergeant Saogu accused pacification commissioner Xiao Hui of three crimes; an edict ordered overseer Aoguzhen to investigate.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Northwestern Route pacification office sergeant Saogu accused pacification commissioner Xiao Hui of three crimes; an edict ordered overseer Aoguzhen to investigate.

literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, the Yasuguan tribe requested to establish banners and drums; permitted.
idiomatic: On gengchen day of the twelfth month the Yasuguan tribe requested to establish banners and drums; permission was granted.

literal: On xinsi day, edict ordered officials of north and south tribes inspecting prefectures and counties and shilie and mili posts who did not govern well to be dismissed.
idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered officials of north and south tribes inspecting prefectures and counties and shilie and mili posts who did not govern well to be dismissed.

literal: Edict: officials great and small who were greedy, violent, and harmed the people were to be immediately dismissed and never again recorded;
idiomatic: An edict ordered that officials great and small who were greedy, violent, and harmed the people be immediately dismissed and never again recorded;

literal: those who were not upright, even if holding heavy office, were to be replaced at once;
idiomatic: those who were not upright, even if holding heavy office, were to be replaced at once;

literal: those who were clean and diligent in self-restraint, even in low office, should also be recommended and promoted;
idiomatic: those who were clean and diligent in self-restraint, even in low office, should also be recommended and promoted;

literal: members of the imperial clan who accepted bribes, when the matter was discovered, were to be punished under the same statute as common offenders.
idiomatic: members of the imperial clan who accepted bribes, when discovered, were to be punished under the same statute as common offenders.

literal: On wuxu day, dispatched Du Fang and Xiao Yun as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Du Fang and Xiao Yun were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday.

literal: On gengzi day, encamped at the Liao River.
idiomatic: On gengzi day the court encamped at the Liao River.

literal: In the seventh year of Taiping, spring, first month, on the renyin new moon, Song sent Zhang Baowei, Sun Jiye, Kong Daofu, and Ma Chongzhi to congratulate.
idiomatic: In the seventh year of Taiping, on the renyin new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhang Baowei, Sun Jiye, Kong Daofu, and Ma Chongzhi with congratulations.

literal: Went to Hun River.
idiomatic: The court went to Hun River.

literal: On xinhai day, made Jurchen Bailü tiyin and Puma Grand Preceptor of the Yanmu tribe.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Jurchen Bailü was appointed tiyin and Puma Grand Preceptor of the Yanmu tribe.

literal: On jiayin day, the Puloumaoduo tribe sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the Puloumaoduo tribe sent envoys with tribute.

literal: In summer, fourth month, on yiwei day, hunted at Heiling.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the fourth summer month the court hunted at Heiling.

literal: In the fifth month, took summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: Southwestern Route pacification office memorialized that the Yin Mountains produced gold and silver and requested a smeltery; approved.
idiomatic: The Southwestern Route pacification office reported that the Yin Mountains produced gold and silver and requested a smeltery; approval was granted.

literal: Again dispatched envoys along the Liao River source to seek mines producing gold and silver.
idiomatic: Envoys were again dispatched along the Liao River source to seek mines producing gold and silver.

literal: In the sixth month, forbade all military colonies from privately selling official grain.
idiomatic: In the sixth month all military colonies were forbidden to privately sell official grain.

literal: On guisi day, edict ordered Xiao Hui to campaign against the Zubu again.
idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered Xiao Hui to campaign against the Zubu again.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the jihai new moon, edict to revise laws and regulations.
idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered laws and regulations revised.

literal: On gengzi day, edict instructed imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Princess Nianmigun: "You will afterward have the status of parents; when the Empress visits in future and you reverently attend the ancestral spirits, reverently bowing before empty tents falls short of the rite of respect; hereafter you may set up portraits and bow before them.
idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict instructed imperial son-in-law Xiao Cubu and Princess Nianmigun: "You will afterward have the status of parents; when the Empress visits in future and you reverently attend the ancestral spirits, reverently bowing before empty tents falls short of the rite of respect; hereafter you may set up portraits and bow before them.

literal: " On yisi day, edict: land within thirty paces on either side of the imperial carriage route that may not be cultivated was not subject to litigation.
idiomatic: " On yisi day an edict ordered that land within thirty paces on either side of the imperial carriage route that might not be cultivated was not subject to litigation.

literal: In the ninth month, encamped at the Liao River.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court encamped at the Liao River.

literal: In winter, tenth month, on the dingmao new moon, edict ordered all tent-palace illegitimate offspring to follow their mothers in rank.
idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the tenth winter month an edict ordered all tent-palace illegitimate offspring to follow their mothers in rank.

literal: In the eleventh month, Song sent Shi Zhongli and Shi Yisun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival, and Wang Bowen and Wang Shuang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Song sent Shi Zhongli and Shi Yisun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival and Wang Bowen and Wang Shuang to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.

literal: On xinhai day, made Yang Youxuan and Xing Xiang examination supervisors.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Yang Youxuan and Xing Xiang were appointed examination supervisors.

literal: On jiwei day, Kuangyi Army military commissioner Prince of Zhongshan Zhage, Baoning Army military commissioner Prince of Changsha Xiejianu, and Guangde Army military commissioner Prince of Le'an Suige memorialized that as each was about to take up his post he requested companions who read history selected; permitted.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Kuangyi Army military commissioner Prince of Zhongshan Zhage, Baoning Army military commissioner Prince of Changsha Xiejianu, and Guangde Army military commissioner Prince of Le'an Suige memorialized that as each was about to take up his post he requested companions versed in history; permission was granted.

literal: On guihai day, made Three Han Prince Qin Qisheng Army military commissioner and Yang Ji Vice Minister of Justice.
idiomatic: On guihai day Three Han Prince Qin was appointed Qisheng Army military commissioner and Yang Ji Vice Minister of Justice.

literal: On jiazi day, made Left Thousand-Ox Guard senior general Yelü Guyü Northern Great King.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Left Thousand-Ox Guard senior general Yelü Guyü was appointed Northern Great King.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao new moon, dispatched Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the twelfth month Yelü Suiying and Wang Yongxi were dispatched as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Xiao Susa and Ma Baoyong as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

literal: On guiyou day, made jinwu guard Xiao Gaoliu Xi Sheli Army xiangwen.
idiomatic: On guiyou day jinwu guard Xiao Gaoliu was appointed Xi Sheli Army xiangwen.

literal: In the eighth year of Taiping, spring, first month, on yihai day, went to Hun River.
idiomatic: In the eighth year of Taiping, on yihai day of the first spring month the court went to Hun River.

literal: On gengshen day, Tangut invaded the border; they were defeated.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Tangut invaded the border and were defeated.

literal: On jiazi day, edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to encourage agriculture.
idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered prefectural and county chief officials to encourage agriculture.

literal: In the second month, on wuzi day, Yanjing regent Xiao Xiaomu requested guard posts on the Juma River at the Song border for patrol; an edict approved.
idiomatic: On wuzi day of the second month Yanjing regent Xiao Xiaomu requested guard posts on the Juma River at the Song border for patrol; an edict approved.

literal: In the third month, encamped at Changchun River.
idiomatic: In the third month the court encamped at Changchun River.

literal: In summer, fifth month, took summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: In the sixth month, made Han Ning and Liu Xiang chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Wu Kehe envoy to congratulate Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday.
idiomatic: In the sixth month Han Ning and Liu Xiang were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate the Song Empress Dowager on her birthday, and Wu Kehe envoy to congratulate Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday.

literal: On guisi day, Acting Northern Great King Yelü Zhengliu memorialized that in the eleventh month of this year the Crown Prince would take a consort and the tribes should prepare marriage-reception tents.
idiomatic: On guisi day Acting Northern Great King Yelü Zhengliu reported that in the eleventh month of this year the Crown Prince would take a consort and the tribes should prepare marriage-reception tents.

literal: An edict ordered thirty wealthy households to supply the expenses.
idiomatic: An edict ordered thirty wealthy households to supply the expenses.

literal: In autumn, seventh month, on dingyou day, made Yaolian tent langjun Chenge Northwestern Route inspector, jointly with Xiao Xie to administer the two pacification territories.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the seventh autumn month Yaolian tent langjun Chenge was appointed Northwestern Route inspector, jointly with Xiao Xie to administer the two pacification territories.

literal: Made Southern Great King Yelü Dilie Upper Capital regent.
idiomatic: Southern Great King Yelü Dilie was appointed Upper Capital regent.

literal: On wuxu day, hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

literal: In the ninth month, on the renchen new moon, made Bohai chancellor Luohan acting Eastern Capital army commander.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the ninth month Bohai chancellor Luohan was appointed acting Eastern Capital army commander.

literal: On renzi day, visited the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On renzi day the court visited the Central Capital.

literal: Bei Dilie tribe military commissioner Yelü Yanshou requested to inspect the tribes and was granted banners and drums; an edict approved.
idiomatic: Bei Dilie tribe military commissioner Yelü Yanshou requested to inspect the tribes and was granted banners and drums; an edict approved.

literal: On guichou day, Zubu sub-tribe chief Hulan came to surrender.
idiomatic: On guichou day Zubu sub-tribe chief Hulan came to surrender.
